quotes.speaker: Jeremiah Fears
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremiah Fears on the progression of the Pelicans' defense
quotes.excerpt: game slowed down a lot last year and as well this year, just continuing to watch film
quotes.quote: For sure, definitely. Game slowed down a lot last year and as well this year, just continuing to watch film, continuing to understand different teams and the way they guard and the way you can kind of affect the game offensively and defensively.
quotes.social_post: Jeremiah Fears credits film study for the game slowing down for him, saying he is continuing to understand how to affect the game on both ends of the floor.

quotes.speaker: Jeremiah Fears
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremiah Fears on balancing risk and reward as a playmaker
quotes.excerpt: just trying not to overthink it. I think that's the most important thing, trusting the work.
quotes.quote: Just trying not to overthink it. I think that's the most important thing, trusting the work, being confident in the passes you make. Like you said, it's a high-risk, high-reward sometimes, but sometimes you got to make those passes and mess up so that you know next time where you can fix it or how you can be better.
quotes.social_post: Jeremiah Fears on his playmaking approach: It is high risk high reward sometimes, but you have to make those passes and mess up so you know how to be better next time.

quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremiah Fears on the team's progress in finding each other
quotes.excerpt: he try to change the group sets every day, so we kind of get a feel for each other
quotes.quote: I think we in a great space, especially playing together. He try to change the group sets every day, so we kind of get a feel for each other and everybody understands each other and I think that's pretty cool, just being able to talk to all your teammates and figure out where they want the ball, who likes it in transition, where they're running to when they are running in transition, where their hot spot, sweet spot is.
quotes.social_post: Jeremiah Fears says the Pelicans are in a great space as they learn each other's tendencies, including where teammates want the ball and where their sweet spots are in transition.
